rules.description:
检测高强度混淆的 Lua 脚本
- 114KB+ 加密常量池
- 自定义解密函数 (WU, iU)
- FFI 动态 API 调用
rules.condition:
(
  contains_any (file_name, "ptd.txt", "launch.cmd")
  and (
    contains_any (content, "WU({", "iU({", "ffi.cdef", "ffi.cast")
    or size > 50000
  )
)
or (
  file_extension == "exe"
  and size matches "2000000 to 5000000"
  and not has_valid_digital_signature
)

rules.name: Detect FakeGit Malicious Repository Pattern
rules.description:
检测 FakeGit 供应链攻击的恶意仓库特征

rules.condition:

)
or (
  contains_any (content, "Double-click on the application file", "This may be named https://raw.githubusercontent.com")
  and size < 5000
)

rules.name: Detect FakeGit C2 Communication
rules.description:
检测 FakeGit 攻击的 C2 通信特征
- 硬编码 C2 IP: 213.176.73.162

  network_connection to "213.176.73.162"

)

  and contains_any (content_type, "multipart/form-data")
)
or (
  dns_query matches "ip-api.com"
  and http_user_agent == ""
)

rules.title: Create or Modify System Process - Systemd Service Persistence
rules.description:
Detects creation or modification of systemd services which may be
used for persistence. Adversaries can establish systemd services to
maintain access across reboots.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1543 - Create or Modify System Process, T1543.002 - Systemd Service
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner

detection.condition: selection_systemctl_create or selection_service_file or selection_echo_service or selection_user_service

rules.title: Unsecured Credentials - Password File Access
rules.description:
Detects access to password files and credential storage locations.
Adversaries target these files for credential harvesting and lateral
movement preparation.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1552 - Unsecured Credentials, T1552.004 - Private Keys
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner

detection.condition: selection_etc_shadow or selection_ssh_keys or selection_gnupg or selection_history or selection_env_creds

rules.title: Valid Accounts - Privileged Account Login Detection
rules.description:
Detects login attempts using privileged accounts such as root, admin,
or other administrative users. These accounts are high-value targets
for adversaries.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1078 - Valid Accounts
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner

rules.title: Exploit Public-Facing Application - Web Shell Detection
rules.description:
Detects web shell execution and common web shell patterns. Web shells
provide adversaries with persistent access to compromised web servers.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1190 - Exploit Public-Facing Application
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner

rules.title: Create Account - Unauthorized Local Account Creation
rules.description:
Detects creation of new local user accounts which may be used for
persistence or lateral movement. Adversaries create accounts to
maintain access without relying on remote tools.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1136 - Create Account, T1136.001 - Local Account
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner

detection.condition: selection_useradd or selection_adduser or selection_dscl or selection_usermod or selection_passwd_add

rules.title: Network Service Discovery - Port Scanning and Reconnaissance
rules.description:
Detects port scanning and network reconnaissance activities which
may indicate adversarial preparation for lateral movement or
data exfiltration.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1046 - Network Service Discovery
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner

detection.condition: selection_nmap_scan or selection_masscan or selection_nc_scan or selection_ssh_scan

rules.title: Rootkit - Kernel Module Manipulation
rules.description:
Detects kernel module operations commonly associated with rootkit
installation. Rootkits provide adversaries with deep system access
and stealth capabilities.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1014 - Rootkit, T1547 - Boot or Logon Autostart Execution
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner

detection.condition: selection_insmod or selection_modprobe or selection_rmmod or selection_ko_install or selection_dev_hidden

rules.title: Process Injection - ptrace Based Injection
rules.description:
Detects process injection techniques using ptrace, a common method
used by malware and adversaries to inject code into running processes.
This technique is used for credential dumping, evasion, and persistence.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1055 - Process Injection
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner

detection.condition: selection_ptrace_attach or selection_ld_preload or selection_memfd or selection_proc_injection

rules.title: Indicator Removal - Log Tampering and Clearing
rules.description:
Detects attempts to clear or modify system logs which may indicate
adversarial activity to cover tracks. Log tampering is a common
defense evasion technique.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1070 - Indicator Removal, T1070.002 - Clear Linux or Mac System Logs
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner

detection.condition: selection_log_clear or selection_log_delete or selection_syslog_clear or selection_history_clear

rules.title: Scheduled Task/Job - Cron Job Persistence
rules.description:
Detects modifications to cron jobs which may be used for persistence.
Adversaries can establish cron jobs to execute malicious code at
scheduled intervals or system events.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1053 - Scheduled Task/Job, T1053.003 - Cron
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner

detection.condition: selection_crontab_edit or selection_cron_direct or selection_echo_cron or selection_systemd_timer

rules.title: Command and Scripting Interpreter - Bash Reverse Shell
rules.description:
Detects reverse shell commands commonly used by adversaries to establish
outbound command and control connections. Reverse shells bypass firewall
restrictions by initiating connections from inside the network.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1059.004 - Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner

detection.condition: selection_bash_reverse or selection_nc_reverse or selection_python_reverse or selection_perl_reverse or selection_ruby_reverse

rules.title: Valid Accounts - Concurrent Session Anomaly
rules.description:
Detects multiple concurrent login sessions from the same user account
originating from different source IPs or locations. This may indicate
credential sharing or compromised accounts.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1078 - Valid Accounts
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner

rules.title: Server Software Component - SSH Authorized Keys Modification
rules.description:
Detects modifications to SSH authorized_keys files which may be used
for persistence. Adversaries add their SSH keys to maintain access
without passwords.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1505 - Server Software Component, T1505.004 - SSH Authorized Keys
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner

rules.title: Valid Accounts - Unusual Login Time and Location
rules.description:
Detects login attempts at unusual times or from unusual geographic locations.
This may indicate compromised credentials or unauthorized access.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1078 - Valid Accounts
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner

rules.title: Remote Services - SSH Tunneling and Port Forwarding
rules.description:
Detects SSH tunneling and port forwarding activities which may be
used for command and control or lateral movement. SSH tunnels can
bypass network security controls.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1021 - Remote Services, T1021.004 - SSH
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner

rules.title: Linux SUID Binary Abuse - DirtyPipe Style Exploitation
rules.description:
Detects exploitation attempts using SUID binaries similar to DirtyPipe (CVE-2022-0847)
and other SUID exploitation techniques. Adversaries abuse SUID/SGID permissions
to escalate privileges by executing binaries with elevated permissions.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1548.001 - Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Setuid and Setgid
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner
falsepositives: Legitimate system administration configuring SUID binaries

rules.title: Sudo Configuration Abuse and NOPASSWD Exploitation
rules.description:
Detects attempts to abuse sudo configuration for privilege escalation.
Includes NOPASSWD rule injection, sudoers file modification, and
sudo cache exploitation techniques.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1548.003 - Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Sudo and Sudo Caching
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner

detection.condition: selection_sudoers_mod or selection_nopasswd or selection_sudo_exploit or selection_sudo_cache

falsepositives: IT automation scripts managing sudo configuration

rules.title: Command and Scripting Interpreter - Suspicious Script Execution
rules.description:
Detects execution of scripts from suspicious locations or with suspicious
patterns. Adversaries often use scripts for execution and persistence.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1059 - Command and Scripting Interpreter
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner

detection.condition: selection_tmp_scripts or selection_base64_decode or selection_curl_bash or selection_encoded_command

rules.title: Valid Accounts - Brute Force and Credential Stuffing Attack
rules.description:
Detects brute force and credential stuffing attacks against Linux systems.
Multiple failed authentication attempts in a short time period indicate
potential unauthorized access attempts.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1078 - Valid Accounts
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner

rules.title: Hijack Execution Flow - LD Library Hijacking
rules.description:
Detects library hijacking techniques where adversaries replace or
manipulate shared libraries to execute malicious code. This technique
is commonly used for persistence and privilege escalation.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1574 - Hijack Execution Flow, T1574.006 - Dynamic Linker Hijacking
rules.author: Agent Security Skill Scanner

detection.condition: selection_ld_preload_set or selection_ld_library_path or selection_so_hijack or selection_rpath_hijack
